plainTranslation: Commitment with a cool edge. Loyal, serious, durable. Can run short on warmth or feel like obligation. Show affection actively; don't ration it. Name the cold instead of calling it depth.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
